name: ovos-phal-plugin-ha-link
description: Links an OpenVoiceOS device to Home Assistant: the device connects to HA itself and carries its bus (and its control panel) to the OpenVoiceOS integration – no open ports, works behind NAT
author: emkay-voice

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
pip install --pre ovos-phal-plugin-ha-link

In Home Assistant, install the [OpenVoiceOS integration](https://github.com/andlo/ha-ovos-integration)
(0.3.0 or newer), add it, and choose **An OpenVoiceOS device**. That lets
devices connect. Then make a long-lived access token: your profile → Security.
